issues.title: Broken Sub-module References
issues.why: The spec frequently references files like '02-error-architecture/01-error-handling-reference.md' which are listed in the inventory but not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Provide the full content of the 02-error-architecture and 03-error-code-registry subfolders in the prompt context.

issues.title: Incomplete GWT Coverage for Phase 50 Contracts
issues.why: The Normative Contract (Phase 50) defines invariants (INV-01 to INV-07) that lack corresponding GWT acceptance criteria in 97-acceptance-criteria.md.
issues.fix: Add AC-09 through AC-15 to 97-acceptance-criteria.md mapping each INV-N to a Given/When/Then clause.

issues.title: Concurrency and Race Condition Ambiguity
issues.why: While retrospectives mention dedup locks, the normative Go/PHP/Python validator code snippets do not implement thread-safe registry lookups or collision checks.
issues.fix: Add a 'Concurrency' section to the Phase 50 contract specifying mutex requirements for registry access.
